0022600156.text: The Clippers, now 1-4 with a four-game losing streak and 0-3 on the road, visit the Warriors (2-3, on a two-game win streak) for the sixth game of the Clippers' season. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram, Jordan Miller, Max Strus and Yanic Konan Niederhauser, while the Warriors are missing Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis and Moses Moody. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Clippers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 115-110 win in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.
